novel_features.name: Trending Delta
novel_features.description: See which MCP servers/skills are rising fastest vs. holding steady, computed from your own browse history.

novel_features.name: Sync Diff
novel_features.description: See exactly which servers, clients, or skills were added, removed, or changed between two snapshots.

novel_features.name: Author Portfolio
novel_features.description: See everything one GitHub org has published across servers, skills, and clients in one view.

novel_features.name: Time-Travel Leaderboard
novel_features.description: See what the top-100 leaderboard looked like on a past date, not just right now.

novel_features.name: Stack Recommendation
novel_features.description: Chain the similar-tools recommendation graph multiple hops to build a ranked shortlist around a server you already use.

novel_features.name: Category Watch
novel_features.description: Flag newly-appeared listings in a category since your last check.

novel_features.name: Duplicate Detector
novel_features.description: Surface near-identical listings from different authors within a category.
